purpose: Teach: 装丁/通信員/前倒し/相殺/概説/差し引い/値下がり/後ろ向き

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、社史の装丁にこだわられたぞ
lines.en: Your father, he cared deeply about every detail of the company history book when we founded it.
lines.style: Measured, reflective recollection. Slow pace with the weight of old memory. Slight pause after 'Dad' — summoning the name itself carries reverence. Voice settles lower on each observation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは海外通信員からの情報を重視された
lines.en: Yes. He trusted the insights our overseas correspondents brought back.
lines.style: Respectful, steady affirmation. Not just agreeing — bearing witness to the pattern. Calm, grounded delivery. Each phrase lands with quiet recognition of the principle.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、納期前倒しを推進されたぞ
lines.en: Your father pushed us to move up every deadline we could.
lines.style: Voice carries a soft wonder, almost tenderness. The pace is slower, lingering slightly on each word. A gentle smile underneath — the kind of memory that catches you.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは損益相殺の判断にも長けてらした
lines.en: Yes. He had an instinct for the numbers that mattered — when to balance profit against long-term strength.
lines.style: Thoughtful, deliberate. Not reciting — reconsidering something understood deeply. Quiet conviction on 'instinct'. The tone is mature respect, not eulogy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、社員教育で会社の概説を語られたぞ
lines.en: Your father used to teach our people the story of the company itself — why it mattered, how it worked.
lines.style: Softer, more intimate than before. Slower pace on 'teach' — as if seeing him do it again. The voice trails gently at the end, holding onto the image.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経費を差し引いた純利益を毎期発表された
lines.en: Yes. He believed in showing the true numbers — expenses, profit, everything transparent — every single quarter.
lines.style: Steady, almost meditative. Clear-eyed and honest, like reciting something that still guides him. No hesitation, but warmth underneath the precision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、原料値下がり時に大胆に発注されたぞ
lines.en: Your father was bold. When raw material costs dropped, he'd move fast — he saw the opening.
lines.style: Admiring brightness enters the voice. A fractional lift in pace and energy on 'bold'. The tone carries both approval and the sting of recognising a boldness he inherited but doesn't always trust in himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員に後ろ向きな話はされなかった
lines.en: Yes. He never filled people's heads with doubt — not once. That was his discipline.
lines.style: Firm, final, but not cold. A gentle closing cadence. The voice settles on 'discipline' — this is the sum of it, the thing that held it all together. Quiet, absolute conviction.
